# Rome Museum

> > Comprehensive booking platform for Rome and Vatican museum tickets, guided tours, and cultural experiences across Italy's most iconic sites.

Rome Museum offers multilingual ticketing and tour services for major attractions including the Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, Colosseum, Roman Forum, and museums in Rome and Naples. The platform specializes in group tours, private guided experiences, and skip-the-line access to Italy's premier cultural destinations.

## Key Topics

- Vatican Museums
- Sistine Chapel
- Colosseum
- Roman Forum
- St. Peter's Basilica
- Private guided tours
- Group tours
- Skip-the-line tickets
- Palazzo Barberini
- Caravaggio
- Gian Lorenzo Bernini
- Naples museums
- Sansevero Chapel
- Castel Gandolfo
- Ancient Rome

## Vatican & Papal Sites

- [Visiter le Vatican: Nos Suggestions - ITALY MUSEUM](https://www.rome-museum.com/fr/visite-guidee-groupe-audience-pontificale.php): Vatican visit suggestions: museums, Sistine Chapel, gardens & basilica
- [Besichtigung des Vatikans: Unsere Tipps - ITALY MUSEUM](https://www.rome-museum.com/de/fuhrung-vatikanischen-garten-offenen-bus.php): Vatican tips: museums, Sistine Chapel, gardens & St. Peter's tickets
- [Visitas Privadas Museus do Vaticano e Capela Sistina](https://www.rome-museum.com/br/visitas-privadas-museus-vaticano-capela-sistina.php): Private Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel tour with St. Peter's Basilica
- [Gruppenführung Petersbasilika - Buchung Führungen Vatikan Rome](https://www.rome-museum.com/de/gruppenfuhrungen-petersbasilika.php): St. Peter's Basilica group tours: Michelangelo's dome & mosaic workshops
- [Castel Gandolfo in Rom - Nützliche Informationen](https://www.rome-museum.com/de/castel-gandolfo.php): Castel Gandolfo: papal residence, Villa Barberini & antiquities tour

## Ancient Rome & Archaeological Sites

- [Visita al Coliseo y al Foro Romano con guía privado - ITALY MUSEUM](https://www.rome-museum.com/es/visita-privada-roma-antigua-coliseo-foros-romanos.php): Private tour: Colosseum & Roman Forum with skip-the-line access
- [Bilhetes Coliseu - Reserva de Grupos Padrão](https://www.rome-museum.com/br/bilhetes-coliseu-grupos-padrao.php): Colosseum group tickets: Forum & Palatine Hill reserved entry
- [Domus Aurea - Rome: Our Offers](https://www.rome-museum.com/domus-aurea-guided-tour-raphael-exhibition.php): Domus Aurea: Nero's palace underground grottoes & Raphael exhibition

## Guided Tours & Experiences

- [Group Guided Tours in Rome - Rome & Vatican Museums](https://www.rome-museum.com/group-guided-tours.php): Group tours: Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, St. Peter's & Colosseum
- [Visitas Guiadas Privadas em Roma - Museus do Vaticano e Roma](https://www.rome-museum.com/br/visitas-privadas-com-guia.php): Private guided tours: Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter's
- [Rome - Visite panoramique en bus à l'impériale - ITALY MUSEUM](https://www.rome-museum.com/fr/visite-guidee-panoramique-bus-imperiale.php): Rome hop-on-hop-off bus: Colosseum, Forums & Castel Sant'Angelo
- [Voucher Regalo – Reservar Entradas, Visitas Guiadas y Privadas](https://www.rome-museum.com/es/voucher-regalo.php): Gift vouchers for Rome & Vatican museum tickets and guided tours

## Rome Art Museums & Palaces

- [Palazzo Barberini e Galeria Corsini de Roma - Informações Úteis](https://www.rome-museum.com/br/palazzo-barberini.php): Palazzo Barberini & Galeria Corsini: National Gallery ancient art info
- [Kapitolinische Museen in Rom - Nützliche Informationen](https://www.rome-museum.com/de/kapitolinische-museen.php): Capitoline Museums: Marcus Aurelius statue & sculpture collection info

## Naples Museums & Sites

- [Chapelle San Severo - Informations Utiles](https://www.rome-museum.com/fr/chapelle-san-severo.php): Sansevero Chapel Naples: Di Sangro family mausoleum & baroque sculpture
- [Capela de Sansevero - Informações Úteis - Museus do Vaticano e Roma](https://www.rome-museum.com/br/capela-de-sansevero.php): Sansevero Chapel: Di Sangro mausoleum, Veiled Christ & esoteric symbols
- [National Museum of Capodimonte - Useful Information](https://www.rome-museum.com/national-museum-of-capodimonte.php): Capodimonte Museum Naples: Royal Palace & Farnese art collection
- [Réservation Billets Musée du Vatican](https://www.rome-museum.com/fr/visite-privee-a-pied-de-naples.php): Naples private walking tour with Vatican museum ticket booking
